summary.plain: The Mu-Pion detector at ADONE: scintillation counters, spark chambers, water Cerenkov counters to tell pions from kaons and iron absorbers to identify muons.
summary.technical: Mu-Pion detector: scintillators, spark chambers viewed by long mirrors, water Cerenkov counters, large iron shields interleaved with spark chambers for muon identification, flash tube chambers.

technology.quote: The setup consisted of scintillation counters, spark chambers seen from above by means of characteristic long mirrors and water Cerenkov counters to separate the pions from K mesons.
technology.value: Scintillation counters, spark chambers read through long mirrors, water Cerenkov counters (pion/K separation), iron absorbers for muon identification and flash tube chambers
